blocks.content:
Congratulations on completing this path.

You read the record Agent Observability keeps of a conversation from every side. You saw the generation that failed, the context the agent had, the agent's versions, the graphs of how its work was organized, and what it all cost.

In this path, you:

- Found the errored demo conversation by its **Status** and jumped to its first errored generation from the error badge.
- Read that generation's input, output, tool call, **Generation context**, and the price source behind its cost figure, then asked it a question with **Debug this agent response**.
- Opened a generation's trace in Tempo and came back through **View in Agent Observability**.
- Opened one agent in **Agents** and read its version history, the prompt and tools each version used, and its pass rate by version.
- Read a conversation's generation graph in **Dependencies** and its step timing in **Workflow**, including the step that made no LLM call.
- Broke the estimated cost chart in **Analytics** down by **Agent** and **Model** and read how its figures are priced.
- Gave your own agent a name, a version, and a client tag, and found them in the catalog and on the cost chart.

Next, [set your own model prices](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/agent-observability/observe-and-troubleshoot/model-prices/) if the list prices do not match your contract, and turn the cost chart into a [scheduled report](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/agent-observability/observe-and-troubleshoot/dashboards/#schedule-recurring-reports) or an [alert](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/agent-observability/observe-and-troubleshoot/dashboards/#set-up-alerts) when a figure crosses a threshold that matters to you.
